rules.title: Nameplate present and stamped
rules.text: At final inspection, nameplate must be present and stamped. Absent/unstamped = FAIL.

rules.title: Nameplate location
rules.text: Nameplate must be riveted to the pre-drilled yoke location, on the yoke on the same side as the body casting markings. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Serial format
rules.text:
Serial format: ^C-\d{4}-\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}$
C = assembled in Canada. Digits 1-4 = work order number.
Before decimal = item/line number. After decimal = unit number within that item.
Example: C-1234-5.6 = WO 1234, item 5, 6th identical valve.
rules.source: Inspection Rules: Nameplate and Tagging, Assembly Sheets 1-4

rules.title: Pos. 2 Version Index
rules.text: Pos.2 Version Index must match ^\d{2}$ (00,01...). Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 3 Body Material
rules.text: Pos.3 Body Material known values: A126 Cl.B, A351 CF8M, A352 LC3, A216 WCB, A352 LCB. Open-ended list. Value outside list and not verified on work order = HOLD.

rules.title: Pos. 5 Size
rules.text: Pos.5 Size must be numeric inches and equal work order size. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 6 ANSI Class
rules.text: Pos.6 ANSI Class must be in: 125,150,250,300,600,900,1500,2500. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 7 Cv
rules.text: Pos.7 Cv must equal work order Cv and satisfy inspection_02 if Type 3241. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 8 Characteristic
rules.text: Pos.8 Characteristic: EP=Equal Percentage, LN=Linear, OC=On/Off. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 9 Sealing
rules.text: Pos.9 Sealing must be in: ME=Metal/Metal, M3=Metal 316SS, M4=Metal 410SS, ST=Surface Stellite, FS=Plug Full Stellite / seat surface Stellite, HC=Hastelloy C, MO=Monel, ZN=Zirconium, PT=PTFE soft seal plug 316SS. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Pos. 10 Trim
rules.text: Pos.10 Trim must be in: 1=Flow divider St I, 3=Flow divider St III, B=Balanced no seal ring indication, BP=Balanced PTFE seal ring, BG=Balanced Graphite seal ring, B1=Balanced + divider I, B3=Balanced + divider III. Else FAIL. 1/B1 must use StI Cv table. 3/B3 must use StIII Cv table. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Maximum pressure tag
rules.text: If ASME B16.34 / B31.3 applicable, a stainless tag riveted or wired to the valve stating "Max. Press <N> psi @ 100°F" is required. Absent = FAIL. Only verified combinations in source: 2in, Class 300, A351 CF8M -> 720 psi @ 100F 1in, Class 1500, A216 WCC -> 3750 psi @ 100F Any other combination = HOLD, reason REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_PRESSURE_TABLE.

rules.title: CRN label for Canada
rules.text: If final destination is Canada, CRN label is required, permanently affixed to body, bonnet, or extension (not yoke/actuator only), showing CRN 0C4462.52 and "Assembled In Canada". Absent/wrong location = FAIL. Not Canada = N_A.

rules.title: Cv without flow divider
rules.text: Rule: Cv not in the set for its divider = FAIL. If Kvs also provided and Kvs/Cv pair is not on the same row = FAIL.

rules.title: Cv with flow divider St I
rules.text: Rule: Cv not in the set for its divider = FAIL. If Kvs also provided and Kvs/Cv pair is not on the same row = FAIL.

rules.title: Cv with flow divider St III
rules.text: Rule: Cv not in the set for its divider = FAIL. If Kvs also provided and Kvs/Cv pair is not on the same row = FAIL.

rules.title: General torque procedure
rules.text:
Wrench held perpendicular. Steady, slow rotation. Jerky/fast rotation = FAIL if recorded.
Only wrenches with up-to-date calibration stickers. Not evidenced = HOLD.
Progressive application: 25%, then 50-75%, then 100%.
Values in ( ) = wrench setting with 10:1 torque multiplier.
For torques >1900 Nm, multiplier must be greater than 10:1. Else FAIL.

rules.title: Seat torque, Types 3241, 3244, 3248
rules.text: Tolerance +/-10%. PASS range = [0.9 x nominal, 1.1 x nominal] Seat and studbolt threads lubricated P/N 8150-0119. Plug stem extension: same lubricant, with lock washers. Wrong tool = FAIL. Outside PASS range = FAIL.

rules.title: Bonnet bolt torque, Types 3241, 3244, 3248
rules.text: ASTM A193 B7. Bonnet nuts must be tightened cross-wise.

rules.title: Seat torque, Types 3251, 3253, 3254, 3256
rules.text: Tolerance +/-10%. PASS range = [0.9 x nominal, 1.1 x nominal] Threads lubricated 8150-0119.

rules.title: Bonnet bolt torque, Types 3251, 3253, 3254, 3256
rules.text: ASTM A193 B7, lubricated 8150-0119. Arrow in source = next higher class, resolved.

rules.title: Regulator torque, Types 2392, 2412, 2417
rules.text: No tolerance stated. Measured != nominal = HOLD pending QA tolerance. Type 2412 torque (IV) has no value in source = HOLD.

rules.title: Type 3241, standard
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Parts verified vs work order (material, Cv, size, ANSI); body flange in vise; black grease seat threads; rotate counter-clockwise to align then clockwise; seat torqued with correct tool/multiplier per assembly_02; grease gasket area and top of gasket; white grease plug stem at packing, plug fully into bonnet; bonnet threaded carefully; grease studs, cross-wise bonnet torque; stuffing box snug not over-tightened (record only); stem lock + coupling nuts installed not tightened; remove from vise; test per inspection files.

rules.title: Type 3241, metal bellows
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Plug in vise without stem/seal damage; white grease threads/stem/2 lock washers; 2 lock washers stacked; bellows housing lowered without dislodging washers; bellows hand-threaded; locked stem/coupling nuts used to torque bellows per assembly_02; nuts removed; white grease bellows nut; bellows tool + retainer used; white grease bellows stem at V-rings; black grease gasket area/top; yoke stuffing box loose; 4 bolts torqued per assembly_02.
Source ends at placing body in vise. Completion beyond that = HOLD.

rules.title: Type 3244, mixing and diverting
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Common: parts verified; body flange in vise; black grease seat threads; counter-clockwise align then clockwise; torque each seat per assembly_02; grease gasket area/top; white grease plug stem at V-rings; yoke stuffing box loose before lowering yoke; grease studs, cross-wise bonnet torque; stuffing box snug not over-tightened (record only); lock + coupling nuts not tightened; remove from vise.
Mixing order: lower seat torqued -> plug into lower seat -> upper seat torqued -> bonnet/yoke.
Diverting order: lower seat torqued -> upper seat torqued -> upper plug into upper seat -> lower gasket/plug + retaining bolts -> bonnet/yoke.

rules.title: Type 2392 regulator
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Body in vise. Arrow plate over cast arrow, 1/16in holes, rivets. Nameplate mounted. Studs Never-Seez snug not over-tight. Seat Never-Seez + torque (I). Bonnet gasket in groove. Bellows/plug stem inspected. Bellows in soft vise. Plug + screw + lock washers torque (II). Flange 4 nuts cross-wise torque (III). Roller bearing Never-Seez, rollers against counter washer. Travel stop M10x1 while holding plug stem. Actuator feedback/control line must point downstream.
Stroke Required/Actual: DN15 4/NOT_SPECIFIED, DN20 5/7.5, DN25 8/NOT_SPECIFIED, DN40 8/10, DN50 12/13, DN65 12/12.5, DN80 20/20, DN100 23/23

rules.title: Type 2412 regulator
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Nameplate mounted. Studs Never-Seez snug. Seat Never-Seez + torque (I). Bonnet gasket in groove. Bellows in soft vise, plug stem lubricated at guide bushing. Guide tube additionally required for 2.5-4in. Gasket confirmed before bellows fitted. Flange 4 nuts cross-wise. Plug stem lubricated 8150-0111 at packing. Bonnet Never-Seez threads/gasket edge. Bonnet torque (IV): no value = HOLD.
Counter-washer: 1750N/4400N springs = 0.8mm, 8000N = 2mm. Wrong = FAIL.
Roller rollers contact counter-washer. Travel stop M10x1 while holding plug stem.

rules.title: Type 3510
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Parts verified. Body in vise. White grease seat threads. Counter-clockwise align then clockwise.
Seat torque = 20 Nm for all Type 3510.
Grease gasket area/top. White grease stem at packing.
Bonnet torque: source states 120 Nm "for all Type 3520" inside 3510 procedure = HOLD. Do not auto-apply.
Plug must move smoothly into seat, else FAIL.
2 lock-nuts, stem 1-2mm above top nut, nuts tightened together. Outside 1-2mm = FAIL.
Locking bracket fitted, valve data facing upwards, lock screw tightened.

rules.title: Series 1a
rules.text:
Verify assembly record. No record = HOLD. Wrong order/tool/material = FAIL.
Clean machined surfaces with alcohol. PTFE O-ring on seat. PTFE holder bore aligned with inlet. PTFE disc. Elastomer insert.
Bottom flange torque = value embossed on flange. Must be read/recorded, else HOLD.
Anti-rotation pin: stem moves freely up/down, does not rotate, else FAIL.
V-ring packing, packing nut hand-threaded. Retaining cord fully around plug.
Elastomer gasket in bonnet without packing damage. Bonnet bolts cross-wise, push stem periodically.
Mirror check plug/seat alignment. Additional instructions for 2.5-6in are blank = HOLD.

rules.title: Setup and external tightness
rules.text:
Test medium air, 4 bar unless stated.
Setup: clamp with appropriate flange adaptors, mount pneumatic test actuator.
External tightness: pressurize both sides with 4 bar air, sight glass or leak fluid. PASS iff bubbles == 0. Any bubble = FAIL.

rules.title: Travel dimension test
rules.text: Travel Dimension Test - PASS iff measured within tolerance, else FAIL:

rules.title: Function and leak test
rules.text:
Function/Leak Test: 4 bar to inlet, actuator thrust per work order/table.
Thrust basis: max closing force 700N = 2.23 bar, tolerance -10%.
Leakage basis must be stated: 0.05% Cv, or values in ( ) = 0.02% Cv. Not stated = HOLD.
PASS iff measured_leakage < limit for seal type. Equal or above = FAIL.
mono: Standard Cv limits NL/h [Cv: metal(0.02%), PTFE, EPDM]:

rules.title: Reduced Cv limits and Dpmax
mono: Note: DN150 row is printed Kvs 280 / Cv 220. Transcribe as printed, do not correct.

rules.title: Function test
rules.text:
Preconditions: required actuator mounted, flow direction correct, setpoint springs fully released, 4 bar to inlet.
Increase signal slowly until plug closed but not tight. Read Rotameter.
Remove signal and verify plug opens. No opening = FAIL.

rules.title: External tightness
rules.text: External tightness: both sides 4 bar, sight glass. PASS iff bubbles == 0.

rules.title: Closing and actuator pressure
rules.text:
Closing pressure bar by actuator area 40/80/160/320/640 cm2:
Max actuator pressure bar: 40cm2=24, 80=12, 160=6, 320=3, 640=1.5. Exceed = FAIL.

rules.title: Maximum leakage
rules.text:
Basis not stated on work order = HOLD. PASS iff leakage < limit for the stated basis.
Other tests (Cv verification, max allowable Dp, min/max setpoint) only if specified on work order, else N_A.
mono: Max leakage NL/h by Cv [in ( ) = 0.02% basis]:

rules.title: Function test and tightness
rules.text:
Test actuator must be 160 cm2. Springs released. 4 bar to inlet.
Increase signal slowly to closing pressure, read Rotameter. Release signal and verify smooth opening.
External tightness: both sides 4 bar, sight glass. PASS iff bubbles == 0.
Other tests only if specially requested: Cv verification, 1.5x rated pressure, Dpmax leakage, min/max setpoint. Else N_A.

rules.title: Closing pressure
rules.text: Closing pressure (160cm2): DN15-25=0.3 bar, DN32-50=0.3 bar, DN65-100 Cv50-60=0.4 bar, Cv94-145=0.5 bar

rules.title: Maximum metal leakage
rules.text: Max metal leakage NL/h by Cv [in ( ) = 0.02% basis]:

rules.title: PTFE and EPDM leakage
rules.text:
EPDM limit = 0.10 x PTFE limit. PASS iff leakage < applicable limit.
Specific sealing force stated 3-4 N per mm seat circumference. No method given: record only.

rules.title: Closing and external tightness
rules.text:
Air 50-125F, full thrust by spring or air.
Setup: required actuator mounted and adjusted, flow direction correct.
Closing: fail_close = remove signal (spring closes). fail_open = apply supply pressure stated on work order. Missing fail_action/supply pressure = HOLD.
External tightness: valve open/partially open, 4 bar air. Sight glass, or leak fluid on packing and bonnet/body seams. PASS iff bubbles == 0.
rules.source: Test Control Valves Class IV / VI, Test Sheets 6-8

rules.title: Class IV seat leakage
rules.text:
Test pressure = lesser of 3-4 bar or max inlet pressure P1. P1 not on work order = HOLD.
Rotameter ranges L/H: 1.6-16, 8-80, 50-500, 160-1600, 1000-10000 at 1.293 kg/m3, 1 atm, 20C.
Source tolerance on limit: +/-10%. Inspection PASS requires measured < nominal limit.
Cv not in table = HOLD. Do not interpolate.
rules.source: Test Control Valves Class IV / VI, Test Sheets 6-8

rules.title: Class VI seat leakage
rules.text:
Test pressure = lesser of 3.5 bar or max P1.
Bubble method: 1/4in tube, 0.032in wall, submerged 1/8-1/4in in water, axis perpendicular. Count bubbles for 1 min starting after first bubble.
Volume method: inverted graduated beaker, ml/min = ml collected / minutes.
PASS iff measured <= limit for method used. Seat diameter not in table = HOLD.
rules.source: Test Control Valves Class IV / VI, Test Sheets 6-8
